issue_context.title: Refactor the `BaseExecutor` in `TableReaderExecutor`.
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

As described in https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/49491, we can refactor the `BaseExecutor` and remove session context in `TableReaderExecutor`.

review_comments: As `IndexLookUpExecutor` embeded the `dataReaderBuilder` directly, it shouldn't embed `Plan` to avoid calling the `ID` of the `Plan` unexpectedly.

It's possible to remove `GetClient()` from the session context. It's only used in executor and distsql, but I'm not sure whether it's appropriate (or whether it's helpful). Therefore, I kept it, and the `distsql` context doesn't need `*Extend`.
